classification: Exploratory retrospective reanalysis of the complete retained 600-run Cooja family; no newly executed simulations
coverage: All 30 seeds x 2 attack settings x 2 timing settings x 5 arms; no outcome-based selection
acceptance: Every decompressed log must match its archived audit SHA-256; four distinct final nodes; raw radio state sums must conserve accounted CPU+LPM time; state totals and offered/delivered/receipts must match archived audits
current_sensitivity: Assumed dimensionless TX/listen current ratios 0.5, 1, 2, 3; coefficient = listen_seconds + ratio * tx_seconds; actual joules require voltage and measured currents
statistics: Descriptive run means across 30 seeds per stratum; no new hypothesis tests, intervals, equivalence or hardware claims; packets are not independent replicates
boundaries: Always-on native Cooja radio-state accounting, fixed four-node topology and checkpoint, public fixture keys; no calibrated RF propagation/current, MCU compute energy, physical timing, battery lifetime or production security validation
